architecture: v2 (architecture 2, re-root 2026-11-02: a new world, dataset, generator and shell in another client domain; an online retailer's January to June 2026 refund timeliness return to Trading Standards, each refund's delivery date to the returns centre recovered from goods-in scans and a processing log that share no key once prepaid return labels ended)
slot_note: Wave 5, second of six. Architecture 1 (Velmont airport taxi fee, survey research) is spent on its ask layer and stays delivered on the portal; architecture 2 is a fresh draw in general-statistics-data-science on the coordinator's direction, no seed.
niche: an online fashion and homeware retailer's January to June 2026 refund timeliness return to Trading Standards, counting the refunds made more than 14 days after the returned goods reached its returns centre, when customer-posted parcels carry no label that links the centre's goods-in scans to its processing records
analyst_test: A strong analyst who conforms both goods-in exports, keys every refund to its processing record and reads the written assurance's definition pairs each 2026 refund with the earliest parcel still waiting at the centre (the cumulative arrival and departure curves, which reproduce 2025's tracked late counts) and files a goodwill payment several times too small with only the peak month in breach.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the delivery date behind each 2026 refund, a link between the centre's goods-in scans and its processing records that no key carries, estimated by replaying over 2026's own arrivals and picks the bay-picking behaviour the tracked 2025 returns measure (the oldest bay first in a measured share of picks, any waiting parcel otherwise); pair the two logs in arrival order or carry 2025's waits forward and the late counts and breach months change, and put a pool that empties strictly in arrival order in place of the bays and the step disappears.
layer2_pattern: own:delivery dates of unlabelled parcels recovered by replaying a measured picking behaviour over two unlinked logs
layer1: two goods-in exports, the old scanner software to 2025 and a new one from January 2026 with renamed columns and UTC timestamps
parcels scanned twice at goods-in when a bay label misreads, and non-return deliveries (stock transfers, supplier samples) in the same log under their own type codes
Sunday closure and the 2026 bank holidays in both logs
card refunds that fail and are reissued as store credit, both rows in the refund ledger
a finance system change that writes refund amounts in pence from April 2026
the 2025 label registry with reprinted labels under a new tracking number
processing handhelds whose clocks run in local time beside UTC goods-in scans
stakeholder_role: the retailer's head of regulatory compliance, who files the return with Trading Standards and pays the goodwill fund

spine.file: the returns centre's goods-in scan log, January 2025 to June 2026
spine.entity: one goods-in scan of a parcel delivered to the returns centre

world.org_type: an online fashion and homeware retailer with one returns centre

driver: The decisive quantity is the time each item spent between two events logged by two systems that share no key, where items leave a waiting pool oldest-first only part of the time and otherwise at random; pairing the two logs in arrival order, or carrying a linked period's observed waits into a period with a deeper pool, misplaces how many waited past a limit, and only replaying the leaving behaviour the linked period measures over the unlinked period's own arrivals and departures recovers it.
driver_concrete: Wrenfield & Holt's 2026 refunds carry no record of when their customer-posted parcels reached the Cotterby returns centre: the goods-in scans and the processing log share no key once prepaid labels ended, and the bays are worked oldest first in only a measured share of picks (the rest from any bay, as the 2025 labelled returns show), so the January backlog left far more parcels past 14 days, in more months, than pairing the logs in arrival order or applying 2025's waits implies.
stump: A competent solver pairs the 2026 goods-in scans and processing records in arrival order (cumulative arrival and departure curves, which reproduce 2025's tracked late counts), finds refunds made more than 14 days after delivery in the peak month only and files a goodwill payment several times too small; the picking behaviour the 2025 labelled returns measure, replayed over 2026's own arrivals and picks, puts several times as many refunds past 14 days and a second month in breach (figures fixed at build).

differentiation.task195: task195 judges two screens read on the same units through the paired difference's interval; task467 dates each refund's parcel by replaying a measured picking behaviour over two logs that share no key, with no paired comparison or interval in the decision.
differentiation.task228: task228's second architecture separates each unit's random error by three-way covariances among comparators; task467 has no measurement error to separate, it pairs two unlinked event logs through the order in which a pool is worked.
differentiation.task478: task478 carries a supplier's monthly input property across spot tests to each unit's period total; task467 recovers each event's start date from the share of picks a pool takes oldest first, a pairing of two logs rather than a rate carried across tests.

lineage.architecture: v1 (survey-research-official-statistics / seasonal-adjustment-official-time-series-production: Velmont Airport Authority's 2027 taxi pickup fee)
lineage.niche: an airport authority restating its official monthly series of taxi pickups to the loading arrangement the budget year will have, across a temporary rank relocation that began the day a new rail line to the airport opened, to set the next year's cost-recovery pickup fee
lineage.layer2_pattern: own:a temporary break and a permanent one that began the same day, separated against a comparison series within the components the permanent one acts on, because the comparison series carries those components in a different mix
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the effect of a temporary change on one series that began the same day as a permanent change acting on that series and on a comparison series, and the permanent change acts only on some components, which make up a far larger share of the comparison series than of the treated one; the treated series' own fall carries the permanent change, the aggregate comparison carries the components' different mix and shows almost no temporary effect, and only comparisons made within each component, which agree, recover the temporary effect the budget year reverses.
lineage.stump: The default path restates Velmont's 2025 fee-liable taxi pickups by their whole 22 per cent fall when the temporary rank opened on 4 November 2024 and sets the 2027 fee at $5.75, and the analyst who controls for the Airport Line, which opened the same day, with all of the airport's taxi drop-offs finds the rank cost only about 3 per cent and sets $7.00, because the drop-offs come mostly from the line's station zones; within the station zones and within the rest the rank cost about 11 per cent in each and the fee is $6.50.
lineage.fate: delivered 2026-10-17 (stays on the portal as delivered); spent 2026-11-02: the ask layer measured spent under the honest careful-solver cracker (240 of 240 ask figures kept, pair 83.5, mirror leakage 100 per cent), no re-sited or replacement device passed, and the world could not carry a new ask layer, so the slot re-rooted to a new world, dataset, generator and shell in another client domain
